messages:
Maya: Thinking about a chill LAN next Friday in the lounge — small, BYOC but we can pool a couple of PCs and a Switch/PS. Anyone down for co-op, Smash, and some good old tower defense? :video_game:
Ethan: Love this. Ill bring my desktop + monitor. Also have a spare wired Xbox pad.
Priya: I can bring a PS4 pad and a tiny Bluetooth speaker (low volume till 10pm). Snacks? I can bring chips.
Sam: Count me in for Smash. Also happy to host remote friends via Parsec again. Worked great last month.
Riley: I'm in if there's room. Can someone confirm ethernet availability? Last time Wi-Fi was struggling.
Maya: Good call re ethernet. Ethan can bring a 16-port switch, and Ill bring a short roll of Cat6. Sam can you bring an ethernet tester?
Sam: Yep have a tester and a couple of spare cables. I'll leave them with the switch.
Ethan: Logistics q: lounge or conference A? Lounge has couches but fewer tables.
Priya: Lounge is cozier. We can clear one table for setups. Also let's set up a quiet zone for folks on calls.
Maya: Start time 6:30pm, wrap ~11pm. I'll put up a sign so folks don't accidentally schedule meetings there.
Sam: For remote players Ill run: `parsec-host start --name "Redwood-LAN-2"` then DM the host id. Also set streamer-mode so mic/game audio routing is nicer.
Riley: Can we do a tiny Smash bracket? Best of 3, double elim? Winner gets a $10 snack voucher and eternal bragging rights.
Ethan: Double elim works. Signups on a google sheet? I can make one and post link.
Priya: Ill help manage controllers and swaps. Also bringing a small power strip and some velcro ties for cable tidy.
Maya: Note: please label your devices. We had a swapped keyboard incident last time. :sweat_smile:
game-night-bot: Heads up: keep volume reasonable after 10pm, follow office conduct, and remember to sign out any shared accounts.
Sam: If anyone needs to borrow an extra controller before the event DM me; I can drop it off Thursday.
Riley: Whos bringing the projector? Not necessary but could be fun for crowd games.
Ethan: I can bring a spare small projector if people want movie-mode between matches.
Priya: Optional mini tournament idea: TowerFall free-for-all between sets. Quick rounds, winner stays.
Maya: Love it. Final checklist: switch + cables, surge strips, 2 PCs, console(s), controllers, snacks, Parsec host, projector (optional). Ill post RSVP grid here by Wednesday.
Ethan: Ill make the sheet and post link later today. RSVP with game and whether you need gear.
Sam: Reminder: label shared Steam/Family Sharing usage and sign out after.
Maya: OK team 389 RSVP in-thread please. See you Friday!
